# Telegraph Glossary

> A glossary whose terms are Telegraph pages. Terms in the user's Telegram posts become links
> to those pages, either automatically in a connected channel (via a bot) or on demand.

If you are an AI agent helping a user with their glossary, use the MCP server. Do not scrape this site.

## Connect (needs uv)

The user's key (Telegraph access token) is in the web app: AI agents tab, or Settings → Key.

- Claude Code: `claude mcp add telegraph-glossary --scope user -e TELEGRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN=<KEY> -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary telegraph-glossary mcp`
- Codex: `codex mcp add telegraph-glossary --env TELEGRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN=<KEY> -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary telegraph-glossary mcp`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add -s user -e TELEGRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN=<KEY> telegraph-glossary uvx -- --from git+https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary telegraph-glossary mcp`
- JSON config (Antigravity `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`, Cursor, Claude Desktop):
  `{"mcpServers":{"telegraph-glossary":{"command":"uvx","args":["--from","git+https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary","telegraph-glossary","mcp"],"env":{"TELEGRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN":"<KEY>"}}}}`

No key yet? `uvx --from git+https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary telegraph-glossary init --title "My glossary"` creates one.

## Tools

- glossary_info: title, public page, term count, whether a channel is auto-linked
- list_terms, get_term, add_term, update_term, remove_term
- link_text: returns the post as Telegram HTML with links, plus the terms found
- send_to_telegram: only with the user's own bot token (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN)
- connect_channel, channel_status: the auto-link bot
- prompt link_post: link a post and suggest missing terms

## Rules

- Definitions: 1-3 plain sentences in the post's language. Markdown is allowed. Add aliases (plural, other language, acronym).
- Ask before removing terms or sending messages. Never invent glossary URLs.
- Storage format: https://github.com/NehoraiHadad/telegraph-glossary/blob/main/docs/FORMAT.md
